name: Xaero's Minimap
author: Xaero96
curator_note: Lightweight client-side minimap with waypoints. A solid vanilla-plus navigation aid; disable for a purist experience.
curator_warning: Do not use XaeroPlus with this mod. The author says XaeroPlus is not affiliated with them and causes bugs and crashes that are hard to track. Source: the author's CurseForge page for this mod (curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/Xaeros-Minimap).
